notes.title: Release Date Reveal!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
Today, We have some special news to share with you. It is...

SUPER SHAKING GIRL !!! will be released on September 5!

SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!! is an action game in which you control up to three unique “Girls” and use the power of cola to soar high into the sky, aiming for any height you can reach. With the power of the girls and your own playing skills, it is not impossible to fly out of the stratosphere and continue flying to the far reaches of the universe. Leaderboard support allows you to compete with the best challengers from around the world. For casual gamers and those who are tired of AAA games and want to play something a little lighter, this is the game for you.

[previewyoutube=cmCWsRSbcFc;full][/previewyoutube]
We are very happy to announce that we are finally able to bring the game to you.
We hope you will enjoy SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!!
